_comment: Data for eotg_lint rule L014 (defined but unused loc keys). For each object defined at the top level of common/<folder>/*.txt, the engine reads these loc keys by naming convention; {key} is the object's key, {n} any number (trait levels). A loc key that matches one of these is 'referenced'. 'verified' says whether the convention was checked against vanilla 1.20 files; unverified ones are listed in eotg_lint.md as UNVERIFIED-VANILLA. Add folders/patterns here, not to the code. Optional per folder: 'nested' {block: patterns} for blocks one level inside a named block (contract obligation_levels), and 'values' {field: patterns} for every value of a named field (custom loc localization_key); {key} is then that block's key or that value.

governments.source: vanilla 1.20 loc for feudal_government: government_l_english.yml:2-8 (name, _with_icon, _adjective, _realm, _vassals_label, _desc, _obligations); gui/character_list_l_english.yml:273,294 (_filter_option, _filter_option_desc); modifiers/modifiers_l_english.yml:586-587 (_tax_contribution_add/_mult), :1027 (_opinion), :1066 (_vassal_opinion); :584-585 theocracy_government_levy_contribution_add/_mult. The modifier forms are the built-in modifiers the engine registers for governments listed in NGovernment.GOVERNMENT_TYPES (common/defines/eotg_government_defines.txt).

decisions.source: L010 implied title/desc; vanilla decisions loc uses _desc/_tooltip/_confirm

traits.source: L010 implied trait_<x>/_desc; leveled traits in this mod's loc

opinion_modifiers.source: vanilla opinion modifier name is the key

deathreasons.source: vanilla death reasons; _killer/_unknown forms not checked against 1.20

character_interactions.source: vanilla interactions; not built in the mod yet

schemes/scheme_types.source: 1.20 scheme_types; not built in the mod yet

laws.source: vanilla 1.20 succession_laws_l_english.yml:14-16 (single_heir_succession_law, _subname, _effects); laws_l_english.yml:31-32 (crown_authority_1, _effects). No _desc: none of vanilla's 217 laws has a <law>_desc loc key (checked 2026-10-08), so it was dropped from the convention.

law_groups.source: 1.20 law_groups; not built in the mod yet

court_positions/types.source: 1.20 court positions; not built in the mod yet

subject_contracts/contracts.source: vanilla 1.20 common/subject_contracts/contracts/feudal.txt:1-5 (feudal_government_taxes > obligation_levels > feudal_tax_low ...); government_l_english.yml:30 (feudal_government_taxes), :33-34 (feudal_tax_low, feudal_tax_low_short). Level keys sit one block below obligation_levels ('nested').

flavorization.source: vanilla 1.20 common/flavorization/_flavourization.info:32-33 ('will localize a localization key of the same name'); culture/culture_titles_l_english.yml:1050 (prince_male_roman). No vanilla _desc form.

customizable_localization.source: vanilla 1.20 common/customizable_localization/00_knight_culture.txt:91-124 (the 7 KnightCulture children: parent = KnightCulture + suffix, so each text's localization_key is read with these suffixes); knight_culture_l_english.yml:12-13,37-40,78-79 (knight_default_*). The bare localization_key value is already a script literal. 'values' = every value of the named field.

_loc_reference_note: Patterns inside loc values that reference another loc key (first group).
